Voidburn Wild Aggro Shadow Priest

This is an aggressive Shadow Priest burn strategy using Darkbishop Benedictus to enable the Shadow hero power.

Mulligan

Keep Papercraft Angel, Twilight Deceptor, Raise Dead, and Shadowbomber. Do not keep any 4 cost or higher cards.

Hero Power

Mind Spike can clear the enemy board to keep pressure or go face against slower decks.
